_comment: Optional MCP server for /blog image (Gemini image generation).
It is deliberately NOT named .mcp.json: that filename is also read as a
project-scoped config, so a contributor working in this repo would have
Claude try to start it with ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} unresolved.
The server is launched through scripts/nanobanana-launcher.mjs, which
serves an inert MCP session advertising zero tools when no API key is
configured -- so enabling this plugin downloads and runs nothing until you
opt in via the plugin's 'Google AI API key' option (see userConfig) or a
This file contains no credentials and is safe to commit.
